name: gpio-game-console / thor-dify-openclaw
install: python3 --version && cd thor-dify-openclaw && python3 -m unittest discover -s dispatcher

terminals.name: dify-dispatch
terminals.command: cd thor-dify-openclaw && DRY_RUN=1 DISPATCH_PORT=8766 python3 -m dispatcher
terminals.description: Thor Dify->Hermes dispatch bridge (stdlib HTTP API on :8766). Runs in DRY_RUN, so it plans robot-dog calls without moving hardware. Endpoints: GET /health, GET /pending, POST /voice, POST /dispatch, POST /confirm.
